## Purpose / linked issues

- Addresses: #
- Development relation: `Refs #N` (research) or `Closes #N` (only when accepted work is actually complete)
- Matching branch: `issue-N-short-scope`
- Parent/epic: #
- Work-ledger task IDs (if applicable):
- Decision record (if architecture changes):

## Change and boundary

Explain the smallest useful change. State what is intentionally **not** included.

## Verification

- [ ] Automated tests and lint run (give commands/results).
- [ ] New behavior has success and failure-path tests; no unproven completion claims.
- [ ] A representative edition/fixture is attached if publication, rendering or delivery changed.
- [ ] PDF/page count, safe margins, typography and imposition are checked if print paths changed.
- [ ] Reader data, source rights, third-party media and secrets are reviewed if relevant.
- [ ] New provider calls, costs, logging/telemetry and network flows are documented if relevant.
- [ ] Documentation, task crosswalk and progress gates are updated **only for verified work**.
- [ ] Third-party licensing and attribution are checked for copied code/assets.
- [ ] No hidden mandatory SaaS, central news corpus or provider lock-in was introduced.

## GitHub project and issue traceability

- [ ] Owning issue is typed, assigned to @yigit-denktas and indexed once in #43.
- [ ] Issue labels, real Project field values and milestone are set where those objects exist (otherwise documented as pending #62).
- [ ] Parent / blocked-by links are reciprocal in the issue, and a branch/PR is linked through the Development panel where available.
- [ ] Closing issues lists actual disposition and updates ledger/crosswalk without counting a duplicate as feature delivery.

## Evidence / demonstration

Link CI, fixtures, generated samples, reproducible commands or honest manual test results. If real hardware was not tested, say so.

## Risks / rollback

Compatibility, user-data migration, permissions, rollback and unresolved questions.

## Reviewer handoff (human / Claude / other agent)

What deserves special scrutiny? What decision still requires a maintainer or founder?
